T: Tex-Mex for the queen of Tejano.
D: The rise of a young Tejano singer from Texas family gigs to stadium stardom.
P: Serve the mains when Selena takes the stage at the big stadium concert.
S: the little family restaurant where young Selena first sings

Corn chips layered with spiced beef, refried beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked bubbling and topped with pico de gallo, guacamole and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with a diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin. Spread 300g corn chips over a large tray, spoon over a can of refried beans and the beef, then 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapenos. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with 3 diced tomatoes mixed with onion, coriander and lime, a smashed avocado and sour cream.
Potato, chorizo and soft scrambled egg in flour tortillas with red salsa
Flour tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, crispy potato, chorizo and cheddar, with a red salsa.
Chopped shrimp in chilled tomato lime broth with avocado, crackers on the side
Mexican-style prawn cocktail: poached prawns with tomato juice, lime, avocado, onion, coriander and hot sauce in glasses, crackers on the side.
M: Corn tortillas rolled around cheddar and onion under a chili gravy

Corn tortillas rolled around cheddar and onion, covered in a chilli gravy of flour, chilli powder, cumin and stock, more cheese on top, baked at 190C for 20 minutes. Make a gravy by cooking 2 tbsp flour in oil, then adding chilli powder, cumin and 500ml beef stock and simmering until thick. Roll corn tortillas around grated cheddar and diced onion, lay in a dish, pour over the gravy and more cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, seared hot with capsicum and onion, brought out sizzling with warm tortillas, guacamole, pico and sour cream. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder and oil. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin. Fry 2 sliced capsicums and a sliced onion hard in the same pan, return the beef and bring the pan to the table. Serve with 12 warm flour tortillas, guacamole, chopped tomato and sour cream.
W: Sponge soaked in three milks and topped with whipped cream
Sponge baked at 175C for 25 minutes, pricked all over and soaked overnight in condensed, evaporated and full cream milk, topped with whipped cream and sliced strawberries.
K: Fresh watermelon and lime drink over crushed ice with a chili salt rim

Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime juice and a little sugar, strained and poured long over crushed ice with torn mint and a chilli-salt rim. Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 3 limes, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain into a big jug and chill for an hour. Mix 1 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill with crushed ice, pour in the agua fresca and top with torn mint.

Add the sliced chorizo and cook through.
Scramble the eggs softly and fold through.
Chop tomato, onion and chilli for a quick red salsa.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the mix and cheddar and top with the salsa.
Chop the prawns and dice the avocado and onion.
Mix with tomato juice, lime juice, coriander and hot sauce.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Spoon into glasses with crackers on the side.
Cook the flour in oil, then stir in the chilli powder and cumin.
Add the stock gradually and simmer until thick.
Roll the tortillas around cheese and diced onion and lay in a dish.
Pour over the gravy and scatter with more cheese.
Bake at 190C until bubbling.

s.note: Potato, chorizo and soft scrambled egg in flour tortillas with red salsa
s.how: Dice 300g potatoes and fry until crisp, then add a sliced chorizo. Scramble 6 eggs softly and fold through. Warm flour tortillas, fill with the mix and grated cheddar, and top with a quick red salsa of chopped tomato, onion and chilli.

s.note: Chopped shrimp in chilled tomato lime broth with avocado, crackers on the side
s.how: Chop 400g cooked prawns and mix with 500ml cold tomato juice, the juice of 2 limes, diced avocado, finely chopped onion, coriander and a few dashes of hot sauce. Chill for 30 minutes, then spoon into glasses with crackers on the side.

m.note: Corn tortillas rolled around cheddar and onion under a chili gravy
m.how: Make a gravy by cooking 2 tbsp flour in oil, then adding chilli powder, cumin and 500ml beef stock and simmering until thick. Roll corn tortillas around grated cheddar and diced onion, lay in a dish, pour over the gravy and more cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes.

w.note: Sponge soaked in three milks and topped with whipped cream
w.how: Whisk 5 eggs with 200g sugar until thick, fold in 150g self-raising flour and bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Prick all over and pour over a can each of condensed and evaporated milk mixed with 125ml milk. Soak overnight, then top with whipped cream and strawberries.

d.note: Fresh watermelon and lime drink over crushed ice with a chili salt rim
d.how: Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 3 limes, 2 tbsp caster sugar and 500ml cold water until smooth. Strain into a big jug and chill for an hour. Mix 1 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip them in. Fill with crushed ice, pour in the agua fresca and top with torn mint.
